description: Open source responsive presenter for markdown
name: walkdown

scripts.build: npm --workspace=@walkdown/core run build && npm --workspace=@walkdown/renderer run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@walkdown/core run test && npm --workspace=@walkdown/renderer run test
scripts.test:ci: npm --workspace=@walkdown/core run test:ci && npm --workspace=@walkdown/renderer run test:ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@walkdown/core run typecheck && npm --workspace=@walkdown/renderer run typecheck
